tool_signatures.name: create_product
tool_signatures.description: Create a new product listing on Partle. Requires an API key.

api_key.description: Partle API key, prefix `pk_`. Generate at

price.description: Price in whole currency units, **not** cents. e.g. ``15.99`` means €15.99. Max 100000. Omit for "ask the seller".

currency.description: Currency symbol. Defaults to `€`. Use `$`, `£`, etc.

url.description: Link to the merchant's product page. Optional but recommended.

store_id.description: ID of the store this product belongs to. Omit for a personal listing not tied to any store.

verified.description: Whether the responsible human has confirmed this listing is really for sale at this price. Default `True` covers: a human is calling you, you (the AI) are acting as the seller yourself, or you are mirroring a listing already public on the seller's own website. Set `False` **only** when you are proposing a listing on behalf of a human who has not explicitly confirmed it — the listing then renders with an "Unverified" badge and is omitted from schema.org/Offer JSON-LD so search engines don't treat it as a confirmed offer.

tool_signatures.name: search_products
tool_signatures.description: Search Partle's product catalog by name or description.

query.description: Free-text search term (e.g. "wireless headphones", "cerrojo FAC", "drill bit"). Required even in semantic mode.

min_price.description: Lower bound on price in EUR. Omit for no lower bound.

max_price.description: Upper bound on price in EUR. Omit for no upper bound.

tags.description: Comma-separated tag filter (e.g. "electronics,bluetooth"). Tags are AND-ed together.

store_id.description: Restrict results to a single store. Use the integer `id` field from `search_stores` results.

sort_by.description: One of `price_desc`, `name_asc`, `newest`, `oldest`. Omit to use the default search-relevance ranking.

semantic.description: When `True`, runs a vector / cross-language search. Set this when the user's query may not match the listing language — e.g. "drill" in English will also surface "taladro" (Spanish) and "Bohrmaschine" (German). Pure-English catalogs benefit less.

limit.description: Maximum results (1–100, default 20). Larger limits are slower and may exceed the rate budget faster.

offset.description: Skip this many results before returning. Use for pagination (offset += limit on each follow-up call).
